address: 52 Dongquan Gate, Guangling, Yangzhou, China Mainland
bio: This no-frills home-style joint has been serving affordable Huaiyang classics for over 20 years, earning acclaim from local food lovers. The traditional lion's head meatballs are prized for their melt-in-the-mouth texture and their perfect ratio of fat to lean pork. The brine-poached goose has firm flesh and robust flavours, as well as a lovely sheen to the skin. The relaxing vibe makes it perfect for a friends' or family get-together....
